name: David Tepper

controls.name: Appaloosa (Appaloosa LP / Appaloosa Management LP)
controls.role: Founder (1993); firm now manages mostly his own capital after returning client money (Forbes: ~$17B)

controls.name: Carolina Panthers (NFL)
controls.role: Owner; bought from founder Jerry Richardson in May 2018 for about $2.2-2.3 billion

controls.name: Charlotte FC (MLS)
controls.role: Owner via Tepper Sports & Entertainment; MLS expansion team awarded Dec 2019 for a record ~$325M fee, began play 2022

controls.name: Tepper Sports & Entertainment
controls.role: Owner; operating company for the Panthers, Charlotte FC and Bank of America Stadium

stakes.name: Micron Technology (via Appaloosa LP 13F)
stakes.stake: ~$1.13B, 14.6% of reported portfolio (sharply reduced in Q2 2026)

vehicles.name: Appaloosa LP
vehicles.notes: Short Hills, NJ; 13F-HR filings seen on EDGAR, latest filed 2026-08-14 (Q2 2026, ~$7.7B reported across ~27 positions).

vehicles.name: Appaloosa Management LP
vehicles.notes: Older Appaloosa adviser entity (FL) in EDGAR company search; its filing list timed out, so 13F status is not confirmed. Tepper said in 2019 he planned to eventually turn Appaloosa into a family office.

vehicles.name: GT Real Estate Holdings LLC
vehicles.notes: Tepper's real estate arm behind the cancelled Rock Hill, SC Panthers HQ/practice facility; filed for bankruptcy in 2022.

privateDeals.what: Appaloosa Q2 2026 13F: new positions in Apple (~$242M), Boeing (~$173M), American Airlines (~$136M), CoreWeave (~$107M), Broadcom and Space Exploration Technologies; full exits from SanDisk, Corning, PDD, L3Harris, RTX and Microsoft; Micron and Alibaba cut sharply.

trophies.what: Bank of America Stadium, Charlotte (owned and operated by Tepper Sports & Entertainment); an $800M+ renovation announced June 2024, with construction expected 2026-2029

policy.what: GT Real Estate Holdings (Tepper's real estate arm) filed for bankruptcy in 2022 after the Rock Hill, SC Panthers facility was cancelled; the half-built facility was later demolished.
NFL fined Tepper $300,000 for throwing a drink at fans during a Panthers game at Jacksonville (Dec 31, 2023).

giving.name: David And Nicole Tepper Charitable Foundation Inc (Short Hills, NJ; ~$70.6M assets at end of 2025)
Carnegie Mellon University (Tepper School of Business naming gift of $55M in 2004; $67M in 2013 for the Tepper Quadrangle)

watch.what: Appaloosa LP Q3 2026 13F filing (due ~45 days after quarter end)
Bank of America Stadium renovation construction (expected to start in 2026)
Panthers 2026 NFL season results and any coaching or front-office changes (the team has had seven head coaches under Tepper)
Charlotte FC's end of the 2026 MLS season and playoffs
